reuse.why: Adds the flag to the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount that every provider link goes through, and extracts unlinkAccount's reset into clearAccountLink so the take-over leaves the holder exactly as unlink does.

duplication.why: The account-link reset is extracted and shared by unlinkAccount and the take-over rather than copied; no other logic is repeated.

placement.why: The take-over lives in the shared link function right after the duplicate-link check, after the closed-account check, and the reset helper sits beside unlinkAccount.

scope.why: Only the flag, the extracted helper, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small and clear; the two consecutive if (alreadyLinked) checks could be a single if/else, a minor readability nit.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All provider link handlers inherit the behaviour through linkBankSyncAccount; unlinkAccount now uses the same clearAccountLink.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the reset block was moved into a shared helper, not copied.
